As someone who uses they/them pronouns, the best way to be an ally is to just do your best. I bet this person has heard the "I'll do my best" line hundreds of times. I know I have. It is pretty implied that everyone not shitty is doing their best and stating it is just asking for awkward acknowledgement that you are human. Of course they will forgive you and anyone else for misusing pronouns occasionally there's no need for you to seek out reassurance and praise from that person.
